title: The Konkan Railway
body: One of the important achievements of the Indian Railways is the Konkan Railway, completed in 1998. The 760-km route runs along the western coast from Roha in Maharashtra to Mangaluru in Karnataka, giving a direct link between Mumbai and Mangaluru. The route crosses 146 rivers and streams and has nearly 2,000 bridges and 91 tunnels, one of them about 6.5 km long. It is considered an engineering marvel. The states of Maharashtra, Goa and Karnataka are partners in the undertaking. During the colonial era, railways had mostly been built to areas of raw materials, plantations, hill stations and cantonments; after Independence, railway routes were extended to other areas too.
